covariates_missing: Selected covariates were not found in the dataset: %s
covariate_missing: Selected covariate was not found in the dataset: %s
covariate_varies: LONG covariates must be constant within each subject. Check %s for subject %s.
long_missing: Selected LONG variables were not found in the dataset: %s
long_keys: LONG data do not contain rows with Subject ID, Treatment group, and Time.
duplicate_keys: LONG data must contain one outcome per Subject ID, Treatment group, and Time combination. Duplicate combinations: %s
two_groups: The Treatment group variable must contain exactly two levels (experimental and control).
two_times: LONG data require at least two distinct time values.
select_group: Select a Treatment group variable in addition to Subject ID, Time, and Outcome.
wide_times: WIDE data require at least two time-ordered variables for both Experimental and Control treatment.
wide_equal: Experimental and Control treatment must have the same number of WIDE time variables.
wide_overlap: A WIDE variable cannot be assigned to both Experimental and Control treatment.
wide_covariate: A WIDE outcome variable cannot also be assigned as a covariate.
wide_missing: Selected WIDE variables were not found in the dataset: %s
car_required: Covariate-adjusted within-subject repeated-measures ANOVA requires the car package.
long_roles: Select Subject ID, Treatment group, Time, and Outcome for LONG data.
distinct_roles: Subject ID, Treatment group, Time, Outcome, and Covariates must be different variables.
separate_blocks: Assign separate WIDE variables to Experimental and Control treatment.
complete_subjects: At least three subjects complete for both treatments at every time point are required.
identical_values: All treatment-by-time measurements are identical within subjects; ANOVA cannot be computed.
wide_blocks: Assign at least two time variables, in equal numbers, to the Experimental and Control blocks.
long_blocks: Assign one variable to each LONG role block.
